info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Filter Segments API

items.docs:
Returns the requesting user's saved filter segments grouped with the
RentCheck default segments. The response is an object with two keys, each
an array of segments (same shape as the create/update response):

- `my_segments`: segments the user owns, sorted alphabetically ascending
  by name.
- `rentcheck_default_segments`: the fixed RentCheck defaults — Needs
  Review, Almost Due, Overdue, Assigned to me, Archived — always present
  in that order. These are not persisted: they carry stable slug

Creates a saved filter segment — a named, colored, and iconed
inspections-list filter combo — owned by the requesting user.

params.name: filterSegmentId
params.description: Id of the filter segment to update.

items.docs:
Updates a saved filter segment owned by the requesting user. This is a
full replace — all fields are required. Only the segment owner can edit
it; a segment owned by another user is reported as not found.

Hard-deletes a saved filter segment. Only the segment owner can delete
it.
